channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Danny Ferry | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Danny Ferry from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Mark Price on Danny Ferry
item.description:
“The next season, we traded Ron (for the draft rights to Danny Ferry), and that hurt us,”

Mark Price on Danny Ferry, Sep 20, 2016. Source: Amico Hoops.

item.title: Adam Silver on Danny Ferry
item.description:
Jeff Zillgitt:Adam Silver on Pelicans/Danny Ferry:

“Danny Ferry has years of experience in the game, an excellent basketball mind and a terrific track record. I am confident he'll be a valuable contributor to the Pelicans organization!”

Adam Silver on Danny Ferry, Jun 8, 2016. Source: Twitter @JeffZillgitt.

item.title: Mike Budenholzer on Danny Ferry
item.description:
Chris Vivlamore:Coach Mike Budenholzer:

“Anyone who has followed the Hawks for the last two or three years knows that Danny Ferry is the executive who is most responsible for the makeup of our team.”

Mike Budenholzer on Danny Ferry, Apr 12, 2015. Source: Twitter @CVivlamoreAJC.

item.title: Billy King on Danny Ferry, Donald Sterling
item.description:
“That was one of the problems I had. Everybody was attacking him without knowing him. Magic probably met him but he didn’t really know him. That’s what happens. You have to know the person before you label him something. Like Donald Sterling, everybody knew that’s who he was. That’s why so many of us came out so strongly (in support) because we have a long history of knowing (Ferry).”

Billy King on Danny Ferry, Donald Sterling, Sep 25, 2014. Source: Atlanta Journal-Constitution.

item.title: Mike Brown on Danny Ferry
item.description:
Four years later, Brown is coming to his defense.

“I cannot say enough about Danny Ferry and the opportunity he gave me as a first time head coach,”

Mike Brown on Danny Ferry, Sep 25, 2014. Source: Atlanta Journal-Constitution.

item.title: Carmelo Anthony on Danny Ferry
item.description:
Ian Begley:Carmelo Anthony on situation w/Hawks GM Ferry:

“I think it was uncalled for. From an owner, from a GM, those are not things you play with.”

Carmelo Anthony on Danny Ferry, Sep 13, 2014. Source: Twitter @IanBegley.

item.title: Carmelo Anthony on Danny Ferry
item.description:
Ian Begley:Carmelo on Hawks/Ferry:

“I’m speaking on behalf of all athletes. We would never look at a situation like that, I don’t care what it is.”

Carmelo Anthony on Danny Ferry, Sep 13, 2014. Source: Twitter @IanBegley.

item.title: Shareef Abdur-Rahim on Danny Ferry, Bruce Levenson
item.description:
Shareef Abdur-Rahim:

“I personally interacted with both Bruce Levenson and Danny Ferry on multiple occasions; my experiences with both have always been pleasant. However, their comments represent a lack of respect and sensitivity for individuals with different experiences and backgrounds than themselves. I pray both individuals learn from this situation and work to regain the trust of the great people of Atlanta.”

Shareef Abdur-Rahim on Danny Ferry, Bruce Levenson, Sep 12, 2014. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Billy King on Danny Ferry
item.description:
Billy King on Danny Ferry:

“I have known him since we were 15 years old. He is like a brother to me and he is the furthest thing from a racist.”

Billy King on Danny Ferry, Sep 11, 2014. Source: Twitter @ZachLowe_NBA.

item.title: Wayne Embry on Danny Ferry
item.description:
“I've observed Danny Ferry and his family for many years and I can say Danny Ferry is not a racist,”

Wayne Embry on Danny Ferry, Sep 9, 2014. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Zaza Pachulia on Danny Ferry, Mike Budenholzer
item.description:
“There is no question about it. The franchise has been great to me over the past eight years from the owners to the front office, coaches and of course the fans. “But I also understand the situation because the [front office] has so many things to do this summer. Danny Ferry has so much work to do. Obviously being somewhat of a new general manager here and hiring a new head coach (Mike Budenholzer). Now they have to fill out the team with players. There are so many roster spots available, so I understand the business side of it.”

Zaza Pachulia on Danny Ferry, Mike Budenholzer, Jul 1, 2013. Source: HoopsWorld.

item.title: Louis Williams on Danny Ferry
item.description:
“Talking to coach (Larry) Drew and talking to (general manager Danny Ferry), I think my role will be similar, if not increased. Obviously, you have Devin and you have Jeff, who are very talented guards, and then you add myself in that mode. I've always been the type of guy that I'm a team player, I'm a team guy. I don't plan on coming in here competing with these guys negatively. I think we can all compete and help us all win games.”

Louis Williams on Danny Ferry, Aug 4, 2012. Source: FOXSportsSouth.com.

item.title: Bruce Levenson on Danny Ferry
item.description:
Hawks co-owner Bruce Levenson said Monday that Ferry has the right character and experience to take over a team which lost to Boston in the first round of this year's playoffs after making it to the second round three straight years.

“Over the past nine years Danny Ferry has earned tremendous respect as a front office executive in the NBA,”

Bruce Levenson on Danny Ferry, Jun 25, 2012. Source: SI.com.
